full_judgment:
2. The facts of the case are that one Mosammat Rehena Akter alias Rumi lodged First Information Report with Kotowali Police Station upon which Kotowali Police Station Case No. 6(7) 2001 was started. The prosecution case, in short, is that her husband used to work in  a fruit selling, shop under the name and style "ভাই ভাই ফল ভান্ডার’’ at Haji Shariatullah Market in Faridpur town on 04.07.2001 at about 11:00 A.M. the deceased left home for the purpose of going to his working place at Shariatullah Market. Soon after the informant heard sound of gun shot and a rickshaw puller also informed her that some disturbance broke out at the shop of her husband. Then she along with Rabeya Begum, sister of the deceased started going towards the said market but the petitioners along with others prevented them on the way but they were able to see attack of the accused per on her husband who used gun, ramdao, dagger etc. and witnessed that accused Alamgir and Mamun were carrying guns in their hands. On hearing hue and cry the accused persons left the place of occurrence. They found the deceased Badal lying in injured condition in front of the shop. Then she along with Rabeya brought the victim to the hospital by a rickshaw van and on their away to the Hospital injured Badal disclosed to them that the petitioners along with two others called him from his shop and thereafter fired gun shots at him, when the victim fell down then the other accused persons dealt blow by sharp cutting weapons on various parts of his body. 

 3. The case was investigated by the police and after holding investigation police submitted charge sheet on 12.03.2002 under Sections 302 and 34 of the penal Code against 15 accused persons including the petitioner herein. 

 4. The case was transferred to the Court of the learned Sessions Judge, Faridpur and trial was started in the Court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Faridpur. Thereafter it was transferred to Druto Bichar Tribunal No. 2, Dhaka on 17.08.2003. At trial the accused persons pleaded not guilty to the charges. 

 6. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the judgment and order of conviction dated 30.12.2003 passed by the learned Sessions Judge and Druto Bichar Tribunal No. 2, Dhaka, petitioners Alamgir and Faruque preferred Criminal Appeal No. 72 of 2004 and petitioner Mamun preferred Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 3347 of 2006, the same were heard with Death Reference No. 166 of 2003 and other appeals being preferred by other con-convicts. The appeals were disposed of by the High Court Division. The appeal in respect of the convict petitioner Alamgir was allowed in part with modification of sentence from sentence of death to imprisonment for life and appeal in respect of petitioner Faruque was dismissed. Rule issued in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 3347 of 2006 having been preferred by petitioner Mamun Bepari was discharged upholding their conviction and sentence. 

 11. It further appears that the High Court Division also considered the evidence of P.W.3 another sister of the deceased who corroborated P.W.1 on material particulars. P.Ws. have been corroborated by P.W.14 Dr. Sohel Mahmud who held the postmortem examination and supported the prosecution case. 

 13. No case has been made out for review of the said judgment and accordingly the same is dismissed.
